fields.label: Dedicated Resources
Max Replica Count
fields.help: The maximum number of replicas this DeployedModel may be deployed on when the traffic against it increases.

fields.label: Min Replica Count
fields.help: The minimum number of machine replicas this DeployedModel will be always deployed on.

fields.label: Autoscaling Metric Specs
Target
fields.help: The target resource utilization in percentage (1% - 100%) for the given metric; once the real usage deviates from the target by a certain percentage, the machine replicas change.
A list of the metric specifications that overrides a resource utilization metric.

fields.label: Machine Spec
Accelerator Count
fields.help: The number of accelerators to attach to the machine.

fields.label: Accelerator Type
fields.help: The type of accelerator(s) that may be attached to the machine as per accelerator_count.
The specification of a single machine used by the prediction
The underlying dedicated resources that the deployment resource pool uses.
